guard_changes.old: access expiry minus current time must be at least 25000 milliseconds
guard_changes.new: An already scheduled visible callback can run while access remains valid.

preserved_guards: Refresh credential must remain unexpired when present.
The scheduled callback must observe visible state.
Visibility transitions clear obsolete scheduled callbacks.
Resuming after a missed lead-time deadline does not rearm that deadline.
Effect cleanup removes listeners and cancels timers.
The shared service retains its existing epoch and pending-request deduplication.

assertion_controls.predicate: Late scheduled callback retains usable manual recovery.
Hiding cancels the visible scheduled timer.
Returning before the deadline rearms the scheduled acquisition.
Returning after the missed deadline does not replay acquisition.
A callback delivered after access expiry cannot acquire.
Timeout blocks hide and scheduled acquisition.
Logout blocks hide and scheduled acquisition.
Expired refresh is replaced while access is valid.

risk: A shared guard could accidentally permit visibility replay. Only the scheduled callback passes the new flag. Existing direct calls keep false.
limitations: Static review does not establish passing execution.
No actual deployed timer occurrence or natural delay frequency is measured.
